hoy.titular: The Clausura ends today, and the Libertadores final is 21 days away
hoy.resumen: At 3 pm Pincha visit Talleres on the final matchday, already out of the play-off race. All eyes are on what comes next: the Supercopa Argentina on Thursday and the final against Palmeiras in Montevideo.
puntos: Libertadores final: Saturday 28/11, 5 pm, Estadio Centenario.
Supercopa Argentina v Independiente Rivadavia: Thursday 12/11, 8 pm, in Córdoba.
Terrace tickets for the final have sold out; the club is waiting on remaining seats.

linea.texto: The final on the 28th is forcing weddings, gigs and birthday parties in La Plata to be moved.
Women's football: a 3-2 win over River at the UNO leaves them one step from staying up.
At 3 pm, the last Clausura match away to Talleres in Córdoba.
Terrace tickets for the final sold out: around 14,000. The club is waiting on remaining seats.
Squad for Córdoba: Jalil Elías returns and Carrillo is rested.

campania.texto: The club's drive to reach 100,000 members. Joining is online and takes less than 5 minutes.
campania.promesa: If the goal is reached, Verón promises to play one more official match at the UNO.

noticias.titulo: Confirmed: the Palmeiras final is on the 28th at 5 pm
noticias.bajada: It will be played at the Centenario in Montevideo. Pincha are going for a fifth Libertadores.
